research_scope.focus: Data across pretraining, mid-training and post-training, supported by controlled architecture and measured training/inference efficiency.
research_scope.architecture_role: 200-hour bounded comparison before the backbone is frozen for data studies; one consequential question, initially hybrid versus matched attention baseline near 1.2B. No broad search.
research_scope.primary_controlled_study: Before main pretraining, screen qualified source/filter/mixture contrasts and confirm the selected candidate against a baseline from matched fresh initializations on the frozen backbone near 1.2B. Predeclare each contrast after source/supply audits; fit screening and confirmation within 600 hours.
research_order: Audit pretraining, mid-training and post-training sources and freeze exclusion/evaluation protocols before data selection.
Qualify hardware/runtime, complete the bounded architecture/efficiency comparison and freeze the backbone; then run pretraining-data screening and confirmation before main pretraining.
Record the comparison result and limitations, select a supported starting recipe, then freeze and launch main pretraining.
Use useful stage checkpoints for capability/context and SFT/RL data comparisons before committing each downstream stage; charge each to its declared reservation.
research_scope.candidate_contrast: Screen at most one code-bank contrast, one natural-web source contrast and one calibrated AI-generation/provenance-filter contrast against a shared eligible baseline. Checked-code substitution remains an alternative only with qualified supply. Confirm one selected intervention; no untested combination or broad weight sweep.

model.architecture: 1.2B all-active 24-layer KDA/GQA reference model with dense SwiGLU
model.selection_status: Reference for the bounded architecture study; freeze the production backbone before data comparisons. The historical qualification configuration remains immutable.

architecture_study.question: Compare the reference KDA/NoPE-GQA hybrid with one parameter-matched all-GQA/RoPE design near 1.2B. This tests the complete design package, including position policy and feed-forward allocation, not KDA in isolation.
architecture_study.controls: Use the same qualified corpus, tokenizer, declared token horizon and evaluation protocol. Report actual total/active/non-embedding parameters, estimated FLOPs, precision, implementation, hardware and measured allocated GPU-hours; matching parameters does not imply matching FLOPs.
measurements: Held-out source/domain loss and development capability at matched exposure
End-to-end training tokens per allocated GPU-hour and peak memory
Prefill latency, time to first token, decode latency/throughput and cache memory across declared lengths and batch sizes
architecture_study.decision: Use predeclared quality-regression tolerances and training/inference cost endpoints. Select a qualified, affordable backbone; retain the reference if evidence is inconclusive and it passes the gates. One seed is supporting design evidence only. Preserve historical configs and remeasure the chosen model before data comparisons.

proposed_control.geometry_rule: Replace all mixing layers with global GQA; keep depth/width/tokenizer and choose the nearest parameter match on a 256-wide SwiGLU grid. No quality-based geometry search.
proposed_control.claim_boundary: 0.866% fewer parameters than the reference. Wider feed-forward layers and full RoPE are part of this control; no isolated attention-mechanism or positional-policy claim.

proposed_runs.initialization: Fresh runs with the same declared seed and initialization policy; unlike data-study pairs, different geometries cannot have identical model tensors.

pretraining_data_study.initialization: Paired fresh initialization seeds; identical initial model tensors within each baseline/candidate pair, checked by hash. Fresh optimizer and data state per run; no trained common checkpoint.
pretraining_data_study.controls: Fixed architecture/tokenizer/context/objective, matched total training tokens and schedule; predeclare the data contrast, domain weights, source families, validation mixture, endpoints and cost. Report actual GPU-hours separately.
pretraining_data_study.selection: Use fixed held-out source/domain loss and development capability/retention curves at matched exposures. Keep final tests untouched. If endpoints are uninformative or gains inconsistent, report inconclusive; retain a justified baseline or revise the design within the remaining budget before recording the main recipe decision. Short-run rankings do not establish a global optimum or guarantee 80B rankings.
pretraining_data_study.accounting: All fresh-arm training, screening/confirmation evaluations, preparation, retries and allocated idle time charge to the 600-hour pretraining study cap. Main production starts fresh after selection; research tokens are not production exposure.
pretraining_data_study.scope: Pretraining study is 600 of the 1,050 data-research hours. Mid-training comparisons have 300 hours on useful base checkpoints; post-training comparisons have 150 hours on appropriate base/SFT parents. Freeze each stage recipe before its production work; these arms do not draw silently from production budgets.
pretraining_data_study.design: Proposed maximum baseline plus three single-factor candidates in screening, followed by baseline versus one selected candidate on two new paired seeds. Reserve confirmation and overhead first. No full-factorial sweep or combined winner without a direct comparison; design details in experiments/main-data/README.md.
pretraining_data_study.schedule_hypothesis: Cagliostro v3 motivates a late-phase math/synthetic reweighting under a warmup-stable-decay schedule. Treat it as a predeclared replacement or later ablation with total exposure, schedule, validation and source identities fixed; it is not a fourth screening arm or a data-only attribution.

candidate_order: One code-bank contrast selected from the fixed source audits; checked-code substitution only if supply supports it.
Qualified FineWeb-Edu versus selected Ultra-FineWeb HQ in the broad natural-web bank at fixed share, with other banks and serialization fixed.
Calibrated AI-generation/provenance filtering versus the same eligible unfiltered bank; detector errors and coverage loss must be measured first.
proposed_screening.selection_boundary: Exploratory only; all arms share one baseline contract. Freeze a priority rule across eligible candidates before results; do not rank unrelated raw endpoint deltas against each other. If no candidate passes, retain the eligible baseline or redesign within the unspent cap.

proposed_confirmation.initialization: Fresh paired initial model tensors and optimizer/data state; confirmation seeds differ from screening. Reusing qualified training families is allowed and counted.
proposed_confirmation.selection_boundary: Report each seed pair and family-level uncertainty separately. Inconsistent pairs or uninformative capability endpoints restrict claims; two seeds do not establish broad training robustness.

mixture.qualification_priority: Prioritize the pinned HQ route. Twelve-shard full token census and exact overlap with retained FineWeb-Edu are recorded in experiments/corpus-audit/data-readiness.json. Preserve the unchanged cutoff and review-only extraction flags. Source-use, broader family/near-duplicate exclusions, extraction quality and eligible supply remain open; no admission.

mixture.candidate_filter_review: DCLM-Edu stricter candidate uses edu_int_score >= 3; edu_score >= 3 is a different filter. Neither is admitted; partial-viewer previews do not establish full-release retention.

mixture.role: Qualified natural code, tests and documentation
mixture.qualification_priority: Retained stock is 0.477B tokens before eligibility, bounding 30% one-pass exposure at 1.59B total tokens. Fixed-cohort reading is complete; preserve all 44 family holds and original frames. Origin coverage remains 28/104 unheld Stack-Edu and 68/70 unheld Stack v3; 75 Stack-Edu outcomes are quota-blocked, one earlier outcome unresolved, and two pinned Stack v3 sources return 404. Resume only after access changes. experiments/main-data/QUALIFICATION.md owns notice/lineage, family and finite-supply gates; experiments/corpus-audit/retained-code-origins.json binds the origin inventory. Natural code and verified exercises have separate gates; no eligible yield or admission.

mixture.role: Checked code explanations, exercises and repair
Selected natural math and worked solutions
mixture.qualification_priority: Full retained FineMath/L2 text-index and overlap checks are recorded in experiments/corpus-audit/data-readiness.json. One normalized link is not an automatic exclusion; L2 row-level host attribution and independent solution correctness remain open. Nemotron inventory has unusable masked object hashes; no shards acquired.

mixture.role: Checked refined math explanations and derivations

main_pretraining.repetition_policy: No automatic repetition. Any repeated source needs declared unique tokens, exposure, passes and revised freeze.
main_pretraining.synthetic_shortfall_policy: Do not count held/rejected records or invent an undocumented join. Re-freeze within-domain natural/refined allocations or reduce horizon after measuring supply; no silent replacement.
main_pretraining.checkpoint_policy: Retain continuation and endpoint checkpoints. Plan the first release around an 80B 4K-base working horizon plus separately accounted capability/context continuation; freeze schedule, staged mixture and endpoint decay after qualified supply and measured GH200 cost. Any return to 100B requires a revised budget and manifest.
main_pretraining.target_status: 80B 4K-base first-allocation working horizon based on the revised 1,800-hour base reservation; conditional on eligible supply, long-context cost and GH200/multiworker qualification, not a launch commitment
main_pretraining.horizon_scope: 4K base exposure is planned separately from 4K/16K/32K capability and context continuation. Initial bank totals assume the starting 80B mixture; revise aggregate exposures when staged mixtures are frozen.
main_pretraining.recipe_selection_gate: Complete the bounded pretraining-data study and document selection or inconclusive outcome before freezing the main starting mixture. No useful pretrained base is required for these fresh-initialization arms. Current weights are preparation hypotheses.

capability_continuation.purpose: Repository, code, math, repair, tool-use and long-horizon agentic capability learning with broad-data replay
capability_continuation.budget_ownership: Capability continuation is part of the 600-hour mid-training production reservation and is separately accounted from the 1,800-hour 4K base reservation; tokens remain unset until GH200 cost is measured.
capability_continuation.data_recipe: Qualify repository structure, dependency links, issues/PRs/commits, verified repairs, tool schemas, grounded workflows and executable trajectories. Report replay, unique, derived and trajectory tokens separately.
capability_continuation.objective: Existing next-token objective initially. Output/action-only loss masks require an explicit adapter, mask fingerprint, supervised-position counts and resume qualification.
capability_continuation.runtime_boundary: Use data continuation for changed 4K capability manifests and context continuation for 16K/32K stages. Do not use a context-extension label for a data intervention.

stages.purpose: Repository structure, repair, tool schemas, short workflows and replay.
Multi-file repositories, issue/PR/commit context, dependency-aware repair and verified workflows.
Long coding tasks, repeated tool calls, test failures, recovery, summaries and state tracking.

data_study.contrast: Screen replay, source-only repository data, grounded workflows and executable trajectories at 4K; separately screen selective loss masks and best-fit packing before 16K/32K production.
data_study.parent_and_state: Same useful parent checkpoint and optimizer state; identical declared schedule and cursor-reset policy. Requires a qualified changed-data branch.
data_study.primary_endpoint: Predeclared repository, coding, tool-use and recovery outcomes; source loss, short-task retention and downstream transfer are guardrails
efficiency_endpoints: Capability versus mid-training tokens and allocated GPU-hours
SFT convergence area and steps to a fixed development target under the same downstream recipe
Early RL adaptation and final held-out transfer under the same rollout and verifier protocol
Preparation, teacher/generation, validation, retry and discarded-trajectory cost counted separately
data_study.branch_controls: Replay is the control. Source-only, grounded and executable branches are proxy candidates; only one candidate is confirmed at 1.2B. Context length and loss masking remain separate factors.
data_study.downstream_accounting: Linked SFT/RL efficiency evaluation is charged to the separate 150-hour post-training research reservation; it is not hidden in the 300-hour mid-training research cap.

mid_training.context_extension: Context changes are the 16K/32K portion of the 600-hour mid-training production reservation; keep length effects distinct from data-family effects.

context_extension.boundary: 600-hour combined capability/context/agentic production reservation, starting from 4K and qualifying 16K then 32K. Stage tokens remain unset until measured cost/quality. 64K/128K requires an explicit later revision. The separate 300-hour mid-training research cap covers comparisons, not additional production tokens.
context_extension.mixture_control: Compare unchanged preceding-stage domain weights repacked into coherent longer records against the proposed long-material/replay weights; neither has been validated for Speck.
evaluation_additions: Held-out fixed-suffix NLL with increasing related prefix length
Retrieval/QA stratified by answer position and distractor distance
Existing short-task retention and multi-file repair

data_study.contrast: Same qualified parent and 16K context: unchanged domain proportions in coherent long records versus a repository/agentic long mix. Both use the same short replay fraction and best-fit packing rules.
data_study.primary_endpoint: Candidate-versus-control fixed-suffix loss at the same long prefix length; also require benefit from related versus short/irrelevant prefixes, positional/multifile performance and short-task retention.
data_study.limits: Requires qualified fixed-suffix scoring and context/restart runtime. This pair does not isolate coherent packing or compare context lengths; 32K follows a separate production gate.

context_extension.inventory_status: Complete-document length bands for retained non-code banks are bound in experiments/corpus-audit/data-readiness.json. Lengths do not establish coherent bundles or useful context. The bounded RL long-context probe exceeds the initial RL ceiling and remains separate from context production.

post_training.counting: Deduplicate tasks/source families; assign each conversation one primary category. Agentic coding counts in agent category, not twice. Held-outs excluded from target. Row shares are acquisition targets, not final token sampling weights. Conversation quotas describe SFT only; RL task and rollout inventories are separate.
post_training.length_policy: Inventory complete <=4K, 4-16K, 16-32K and 32-128K examples. Train only within the qualified context ceiling; 32-128K stock is stretch inventory, not promised first-release exposure.
post_training.boundary: 4K-rate scenarios omit variable padding, long attention cost, evaluation, teacher generation, verification and retries. The 800-hour reservation covers SFT, optional verified-reward RL, teacher/verification work and final self-SFT; additions must fit or displace work. No multi-epoch commitment. The separate 150-hour post-training data-research cap covers comparison arms and their overhead, not production exposure; charge every job once.

stage_design.sft: Length-bucketed assistant-masked thinking and tool supervision; shorter qualified buckets first, then mixed short and long examples through the validated context ceiling. One unique-task inventory, explicit exposure and replay accounting.
stage_design.rl: Proposed bounded GRPO-style verifiable-reward training after a useful SFT baseline; qualify implementation, rollout engine, task verifiers and recovery first. No qualified RL trainer currently exists in the repo.
stage_design.final_self_sft: After selecting the SFT or RL parent, freeze a prompt pool, generate tool-aware responses in pinned environments, verify and deduplicate them, mix with verified anchor data, and run final assistant-masked self-SFT. Preserve the pre-self-SFT parent and promote only on held-out transfer.
stage_design.rl_initial_scope: Checkable math and sandboxed code tasks; proposed initial total context ceiling 16K, then 32K only if useful and affordable. Output and tool-step caps frozen separately. Agent/environment RL conditional on reliable executable tasks.
stage_design.rl_cost_boundary: Charge rollout generation, reference-policy/scoring passes, updates, evaluation, retries and allocated idle GPUs. CPU sandbox costs recorded separately; no 128K RL commitment.
stage_design.release_selection: Retain base and SFT checkpoints. Promote RL checkpoint only for measured gains without unacceptable regressions; otherwise release the SFT thinking assistant.

data_study.sft_contrast: Eligible baseline thinking/tool data versus a declared outcome-verification selection from the same candidate pool; both exclude known-invalid examples. Hold task and length strata, serialization and masking fixed.
data_study.sft_exposure: Same useful parent, fresh optimizer and paired data-order seeds. Match planned processed positions/bucket cycles and predeclare a supervised-token mismatch tolerance. Current SFT runs complete finite epochs; arbitrary supervised-token stopping is not implemented.
data_study.sft_primary_endpoint: Predeclared held-out code/math or tool-task success metric matching the selected intervention; protocol compliance and other capabilities are guardrails.
data_study.rl_scope: Conditional fixed-SFT-policy prompt/rollout and verifier feasibility only in the 20-hour research slot. Policy optimization belongs to the separate 200-hour production cap after runtime, reward and recovery qualification.
data_study.final_self_sft_scope: A 30-hour pilot compares verified-anchor continuation with verified self-distillation plus anchor replay. Full final self-SFT remains within the 800-hour post-training production reservation and starts from the promoted RL checkpoint or selected SFT fallback.
data_study.limits: Selection changes task distribution and possibly supervision density; disclose remaining differences rather than attributing everything to verification. Final tests remain untouched.
data_study.downstream_accounting: SFT comparison uses 80 hours, fixed-policy RL feasibility 20 hours, final self-SFT pilot 30 hours and support 20 hours; production SFT/RL/self-SFT exposure remains in the separate 800-hour reservation.

post_training.qualification_status: experiments/corpus-audit/data-readiness.json records the full retained SFT structural census, unchanged deterministic samples at four serialized context ceilings, prompt links and bounded RL reference/schema inventory. Format compatibility is not answer quality or thinking/tool success. Preserve source records and missing-tail limitations; no admission or RL launch.

main_scenarios.role: revised first-allocation 4K-base working horizon, conditional on measured cost and supply
deferred scale comparison; not a first-allocation target
deferred scale comparison; not a first-allocation target

compute.boundary: H100 measured full-trainer rate includes startup, validation and saves, not setup, external capability evaluation, transfer/idle or provider billing. No GH200/multiworker scaling claim. Effective rate divides aggregate throughput by every allocated GPU. Do not spend protected mid-training/SFT/evaluation budgets on base expansion.
compute.allocation_interpretation: The grant allocation is 5,000 total GPU-hours across four GH200s, equivalent to 1,250 four-GPU elapsed hours, within a nominal 90-day access window. Hardware and envelope are confirmed; access start, site details and throughput remain pending qualification.
compute.scaling_boundary: Illustrative 80% efficiency is not measured. Four GPUs at H100 per-device speed yield 51,437 aggregate tokens/s at perfect scaling or 41,149 at 80%; GPU-hour cost is invariant at perfect scaling and rises with inefficiency. GH200 per-device gains require measurement.
compute.breakdown_status: The 5000-hour research-and-release envelope is a planning cap, not a measured requirement or job authorization. Research includes each experiment's evaluation/preparation/retries; production phases have separate exposure ledgers.
compute.reservation_revision: Research-first allocation: runtime 100, architecture/efficiency 200, data research 1,050 (600/300/150), 4K base production 1,800, combined capability/context/agentic mid-training production 600, post-training production 800 and protected evaluation/recovery 450. External H100 rentals remain separate; no repeat engineering pilot.

main_budget_feasibility.boundary: Linear H100 full-trainer extrapolation; not a guaranteed GH200 ceiling. The revised 80B 4K-base horizon leaves little margin at the measured rate and roughly 66.7B at an illustrative 80% rate; long-context and agentic phases require separate measured costing. Do not borrow protected stage budgets.

compute.research_subdivision_status: Proposed spending ceilings inside the 200/600/300/150 reservations, not runnable jobs or additional GPU-hours. Training caps include trainer startup, saves and inline validation; shared support covers other on-allocation preparation, scoring, qualification and recovery. Account each operation once. Reduce scope or record an explicit revision if measured costs do not fit; no silent transfers from confirmation or production.

storage.boundary: Token IDs only; indexes, masks, raw text, deduplication databases, checkpoints and backups cost extra. Two-TB scratch is a working allowance, not a measured footprint. Acquisition should be bounded and streamed.

launch_requirements: confirmed hardware and measured multiworker runtime
completed architecture/efficiency comparison and frozen backbone before pretraining-data experiments
shared stage-conditioned data-design contract bound to every data manifest
qualified per-source supply and revised manifest
completed pretraining-data comparison and documented starting-recipe decision before main pretraining
joint source-family exclusions and validation split
post-training full-context and supervised token counts
frozen optimizer schedule and stop budget

program_objective.initialization: from scratch; external pretrained base adaptation is excluded
release_targets: open technical report and reproducibility artifacts
program_objective.future_compute_status: aspiration; not confirmed allocation or spend authorization

preserved_evidence.engineering_pilot: completed with training, export, development evaluation and verified backups
preserved_evidence.pilot_configurations: frozen; this working plan does not rewrite the pilot recipe
preserved_evidence.external_rental_billing: actual bill and provider stop state unconfirmed; no remaining pilot GPU task

input_receipt_policy: Current working-plan input identities refreshed at plan revision; completed experiment receipts remain unchanged.
launch_requirement_scope: Requirements apply before the relevant phase: long-context cost and SFT token counts are downstream gates, not prerequisites for designing or launching qualified 4K pretraining research. No stage skips its own data, runtime, evaluation or cost qualification.
